title: The classification of taut surface singularities via representations from logarithmic vector fields
summary: We study logarithmic vector fields on exceptional cycles through finite-dimensional representations and recover Laufer's classification of taut normal complex surface singularities. For graphs with two nodes, restriction maps define representations of a fixed quiver, with dimensions bounded independently of the number of components and their self-intersections. We identify restriction cohomology with an extension group and use interval decomposition to reduce its vanishing to interpolation on a rational chain.
